statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations
The patient has known atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has unexplained symptoms captured by diagnosis R55
CPT code 93229 (Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to assess the efficacy of current rate control management
Standard in-office ECG monitoring alone cannot achieve the necessary assessment
